CustomField.description: Auto-calculated risk indicator based on negative sentiment + high influence/power
CustomField.formula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Sentiment__c, "Negative"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Influence_Level__c, "High"), ISPICKVAL(Decision_Power__c, "High"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "Blocker"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Influence_Level__c, "High"), ISPICKVAL(Influence_Level__c, "Medium"))), Days_Since_Last_Engagement__c > 30 )
CustomField.label: Risk Flag
